slides.heading: insert()
slides.body: insert() is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: insert()
slides.body: insert() adds an item at a specific index. Existing items move to make room for the new item.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: insert() is like adding a student into a specific place in a line.
